forms.title: Equal, opposite, parallel or neither
forms.skill: Compare two vectors: equal, opposite, parallel or none of these.

variants.statement: How are $\vec{u} = (2; 5)$ and $\vec{v} = (2; 5)$ related?
variants.explanation: Two vectors are parallel exactly when $u_1 v_2 - u_2 v_1 = 0$; here that is $(2)(5) - (5)(2) = 0. $ So they are parallel. Equal means the same multiplier $1$, opposite means $-1$, and any other non-zero multiplier leaves them parallel without being either.
